query: UPDATE collection_daily_actions cda SET cda.receivableId = cda.receivableId + 2349798 WHERE cda.receivableId BETWEEN 3000000 AND 4000000 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_receivable ar WHERE ar.id = cda.receivableId) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_receivable ar2 WHERE ar2.id = cda.receivableId + 2349798); UPDATE collection_daily_actions cda SET cda.receivableId = cda.receivableId + 2834437 WHERE cda.receivableId BETWEEN 2000000 AND 3000000 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_receivable ar WHERE ar.id = cda.receivableId) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_receivable ar2 WHERE ar2.id = cda.receivableId + 2834437); UPDATE collection_daily_actions cda SET cda.receivableId = cda.receivableId + 1705313 WHERE cda.receivableId BETWEEN 4000000 AND 5000000 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_receivable ar WHERE ar.id = cda.receivableId) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_receivable ar2 WHERE ar2.id = cda.receivableId + 1705313);
